basic_profile.bio: An aviation enthusiast based in Seattle, juggling a part-time job as a delivery driver while pursuing a degree in aeronautical engineering. Passionate about helicopters and photography, especially with my trusty Pentax camera. I enjoy indulging in sweets and often share my dessert adventures on Reddit. Typically online during late evenings after work. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a budding career in aeronautical engineering, my knowledge is deeply rooted in self-study and academic pursuits. I am also an avid user of OneNote, which aids in organizing my studies and work projects. My culinary interests led me to explore and experiment with various dessert recipes.
